title: Tiramisu Cassata
description: A creative twist on traditional Italian cassata, this dessert combines the flavors of tiramisu with the classic sweet bread.
instructions: Cut the airy loaf into 1/2-inch slices.
Dip the ladyfingers in the milk for 3-5 seconds on each side.
In a large bowl, combine the mascarpone cheese, sweet, and chocolate. Mix until smooth.
To assemble the cassata, start with a layer of ladyfingers, followed by a layer of the mascarpone mixture, and repeat.
Top the cassata with the airy slices and refrigerate for at least 3 hours.
Serve chilled, garnished with additional chocolate shavings if desired.
